spec_family.name: New Construction Interior Trim Priming
spec_family.description: Primer application for interior trim (baseboard, door casing, window casing, other trim) in new construction. Covers substrate-specific primer selection: factory-primed trim (optional additional primer), bare MDF (solvent-based edge sealer + latex face primer), bare FJP (stain-blocking primer required), bare solid wood (standard primer-sealer), and glossy/oil-based existing substrates (bonding primer). Primer requirement is driven by substrate_condition dimension, NOT quality tier. Uses LF as primary UOM per PDCA standard (1 LF trim = 1 SF). This spec is PRIME ONLY - finish coats belong to SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary driver for primer system selection. Each substrate type requires different primer chemistry.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Factory primed is NC default. MDF requires two-step process (edge seal + face prime). FJP requires stain-blocking (mandatory).

configuration_dimensions.description: User choice to add additional primer coat on factory-primed trim.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Factory primer is transit protection, often thin. Additional primer recommended for quality work but user-configurable.

configuration_dimensions.description: Drives inspection/repair intensity and scrutiny. Does NOT affect primer selection.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT3=quick glance at 6ft, QT4=systematic scan at 3ft, QT5=lighted critical at arm's length. Per Fine_Finish_Doctrine.
Brush is NC production standard for trim. Spray requires wall protection but faster for large scope.

configuration_dimensions.description: Trim profile complexity affecting production rates.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Simple=0.85x, Standard=1.0x, Complex=1.25x, Ornate=1.40x per Millwork_NC_Paint_Doctrine Section 7.2.

configuration_dimensions.description: Height of trim work affecting production via height modifiers.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Standard (7-8ft)=H1, Tall (9-12ft)=H2, High (13ft+)=H3. Primarily affects crown molding and high casing.

critical_constraints.substrate_driven_primer: Primer selection is driven by substrate_condition dimension, NOT quality tier. Per Fine_Finish_Doctrine Section 2.1 - mandatory doctrine.
critical_constraints.mdf_edge_sealer_mandatory: MDF edges MUST receive solvent-based sealer (shellac or oil-based) BEFORE any latex products. Water-based primers cause irreversible fiber raise on MDF edges.
critical_constraints.fjp_stain_blocking_mandatory: FJP (Finger-Joint Pine) REQUIRES stain-blocking primer. Without stain-blocking, resin bleed will occur. NOT optional, NOT configurable.
critical_constraints.pdca_lf_sf_standard: Per PDCA standard, 1 LF of trim = 1 SF regardless of actual width. Do not convert based on profile width.
critical_constraints.application_quality_not_tiered: Primer application quality (drips, sags, holidays) must meet standard at ALL quality tiers. Application defects are workmanship failures, not tier differences.

change_log.changes: Trim item ID cleanup: (1) Removed _PRIME suffix from ITM_TRIM_BASEBOARD_PRIME, ITM_TRIM_CASING_DOOR_PRIME, ITM_TRIM_CASING_WINDOW_PRIME — items represent physical objects, not phases. (2) Replaced ITM_TRIM_OTHER_PRIME catch-all with 6 specific trim type items: ITM_TRIM_CROWN, ITM_TRIM_CHAIR_RAIL, ITM_TRIM_WAINSCOT_RAIL, ITM_TRIM_SHADOW_BOX, ITM_TRIM_PANEL_MOLD, ITM_TRIM_PICTURE_RAIL.
